labels.working: Live omp pane with active execution evidence, spinner/status and active work/session marker.
labels.idle: Live omp agent with no active work evidence and no qualifying wait stall.
labels.stalled-wait: Wait state beyond configured stall interval with no active work evidence.
labels.no-agent: No live omp agent in the pane process tree.

boundary: This is a keyless hand-label of 100 real polls (400 pane observations), not a Jev result. The live Jev retry remains disabled.
